onboarding.title: ScrapTrace
onboarding.subtitle: Public E-Waste Recovery & Traceability Infrastructure. Choose language to proceed.
onboarding.note: Public recovery networks enforce offline reliability. Local settings cached automatically on confirmation.

privacy.title: Privacy & Data Governance
privacy.subtitle: Public service protocols protect your personal details while verifying ecological outcomes.
privacy.requiredText: Capture photo evidence of recovery state (materials check), record GPS coordinates (trusted audit loop), and preserve device records.
privacy.optionalText: Allow image-based classification models to train on anonymous physical wear & tear profiles to improve automated classification.
privacy.noteText: Camera access requested only when Capture is initiated. Location verification requested only for Nearby and Verified GPS records.

collectorHome.registerText: Photograph the item, confirm what it is, read the approved safety guide and create a record with a QR code.
collectorHome.noRecords: You have not created a record yet. Start with a capture.
collectorHome.privacy: Privacy reminder: ScrapTrace records material volume only. Avoid photographing faces or personal details.

records.emptyDescription: No record matches the current filters.

capture.previewAlternative: The photograph you accepted for this record
capture.imageHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 12 MB. The photograph is reduced on this device before it is stored.
capture.imageNotReduced: Stored as supplied ({size} kB): this device could not reduce it.
capture.imageRequired: Add a photograph of the item.

imageRejected.unsupported_type: Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
imageRejected.too_large: That image is larger than 12 MB. Take a new photograph or choose a smaller file.

capture.suggestionNotice: This is a suggestion from a single-image classifier. It cannot count items or measure weight, so confirm it or choose another category.

confidence.high: The model scored this category {value}. That is a strong score, but still confirm it.
confidence.medium: The model scored this category {value}. Check the item before confirming.
confidence.low: The model scored this category only {value}. Choose the category yourself.

capture.lowConfidence: The model was not confident enough to suggest a category. Choose the category yourself, or take another photograph.
capture.unavailableSuggestion: The suggestion service could not read this photograph. Choose the category yourself, or take another photograph.
capture.categoryHint: The confirmed category drives the safety guide and the estimate.
capture.correctionHint: Your reason is stored with the original suggestion. The suggestion is never overwritten.
capture.correctionRequired: Give a short reason for choosing a different category.
capture.countInvalid: Enter a whole number of one or more.
capture.batchNoticeTitle: Mixed scrap is recorded as a batch
capture.batchNotice: A mixed batch has no item count. An approximate weight is required instead, because a photograph cannot measure weight.
capture.weightHintRequired: Required for mixed scrap. Use a scale or a known package weight.
capture.weightHintOptional: Optional. Add it if you know it, so the receiving facility can compare.
capture.weightRequired: Enter an approximate weight in kilograms.
capture.weightInvalid: Enter a weight greater than zero.
capture.areaHint: A coarse area only. Your precise position is never required.
capture.locationHint: Location is requested only when you use this control.
capture.locationDenied: Position was not shared. The chosen area is used instead.
capture.locationUnsupported: This browser cannot provide a position. The chosen area is used instead.
capture.destinationHint: Optional. Choosing one now lets that facility find the record faster.
capture.safetyCardUsed: This record references safety card {version} in {language}.
capture.draftUnavailable: This draft is unavailable or can no longer be edited.
capture.submitted: Record {reference} submitted and ready for handoff.
capture.submittedWithFlag: Record {reference} submitted. Identical photograph content already exists on another record, so it has been flagged for review.
capture.fixErrors: Some details still need attention. Check the highlighted fields.
capture.privacyReminder: ScrapTrace stores the photograph, the approximate area and the details above. It does not store your name or telephone number in the QR code.

account.identifierNotice: This is an opaque demonstration identifier. It is not a name and it never appears in a QR code.
account.notDurable: No — this browser is not storing data
account.clearHint: Removes the records and drafts held on this device. Records already accepted by the service are not affected.

clearCache.title: Clear device records
clearCache.warningText: You are about to delete {records} record(s) held on this device, including {drafts} unsubmitted draft(s).
clearCache.warningStrong: Records already accepted by the service remain intact.
clearCache.notDurableTitle: This browser is not storing data
clearCache.notDurable: Nothing is being kept between refreshes, so there may be little to clear.
clearCache.storageWarningTitle: The last save did not complete

storageWarning.storage_full: Device storage is full. Clear records to free space.
storageWarning.storage_unavailable: Device storage is unavailable, so recent work was not saved.
storageWarning.serialization_failed: Recent work could not be prepared for storage and was not saved.

clearCache.reseedNotice: Initial demonstration data is restored the next time this workspace is opened.
clearCache.confirmDescription: {records} record(s) will be removed from this device.
clearCache.cancel: Keep the records on this device

recyclerHome.verifyText: Scan a collector's QR code, read it from a photograph, or type the transfer code to confirm receipt.
recyclerHome.bucketEmpty: Nothing in this list right now.

recyclerIntake.scanText: Use the camera, choose a photograph of the code, or type the transfer code printed under it.
recyclerIntake.lookupFailedTitle: The code could not be looked up
recyclerIntake.notFound: Check the transfer code, or ask the collector to show the QR code again. No owner details are shown for an unknown code.
recyclerIntake.unsupportedVersionTitle: That code uses an unsupported contract version
recyclerIntake.unsupportedVersion: This application cannot read that code. Ask the collector to reopen the record and present a current code.
recyclerIntake.notReadyTitle: That record is not ready for handoff
recyclerIntake.notReady: The collector has not submitted and published it yet, so receipt cannot be recorded.
recyclerIntake.otherFacilityTitle: That record belongs to another facility
recyclerIntake.otherFacility: It is destined for a receiving location this account is not assigned to, so it cannot be received here.
recyclerIntake.alreadyReceivedNotice: Scanning the same code again shows the first receipt instead of recording another one.
recyclerIntake.categoryChangedTitle: This differs from the collector's category
recyclerIntake.categoryChanged: A different category is recorded as a review flag, not as a correction of the collector's record.
recyclerIntake.noDeclaredWeight: The collector declared no weight, so no weight comparison is possible.
recyclerIntake.weightRequired: Enter a received weight greater than zero.
recyclerIntake.discrepancyWarningTitle: This will be flagged for review
recyclerIntake.discrepancyWarning: The received weight differs from the declared weight by {difference}, which is beyond the programme threshold of {threshold}%.
recyclerIntake.priceHint: In {currency}. Enter 0 if nothing was paid.
recyclerIntake.priceInvalid: Enter a price of zero or more.
recyclerIntake.evidenceHint: A handoff photograph and a readable scale photograph are both required before receipt can be recorded.
recyclerIntake.handoffPhotoAlternative: The handoff photograph recorded for this receipt
recyclerIntake.weightPhotoAlternative: The scale photograph recorded for this receipt
recyclerIntake.weightPhotoRequired: Add a photograph of the scale reading.

imageRejected.unsupported_type: Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
imageRejected.too_large: That image is larger than 12 MB. Take a new photograph or choose a smaller file.

recyclerIntake.confirmDescription: Record {reference} will be marked received at {weight}.
recyclerIntake.idempotencyNotice: Confirming twice records one handoff: a repeat is treated as the same action and returns the first result.
recyclerIntake.fixErrors: Some details still need attention. Check the highlighted fields.
recyclerIntake.rejectedToast: Receipt was not recorded. Read the reason on the form.
recyclerIntake.acceptedNotice: No flags were raised. Record the processing details next.
recyclerIntake.discrepancyToast: Receipt recorded. The record was flagged for review.
recyclerIntake.flaggedNotice: The receipt was recorded in full. A programme reviewer will look at the flags below and decide.
recyclerIntake.flaggedNextStep: You can still record the processing details. The record cannot count towards verified recovery until a reviewer approves it.
recyclerIntake.duplicateToast: Already received. The first receipt is shown.
recyclerIntake.duplicateNotice: No second handoff was created. The original receipt stands.
recyclerIntake.programmeUnavailable: Programme settings could not be loaded. Try again.

reviewer.noResults: No record matches the current filters.
reviewer.tableCaption: Records awaiting a programme review decision

manager.verifiedText: Only records in the approved and completed state contribute to these totals. Drafts, records under review and rejected records are excluded.
manager.discrepancyNotice: {count} record(s) carry at least one review flag. A flag needs human judgement and is not proof of wrongdoing.
manager.stateChartSummary: Counts of records in each lifecycle state, from a total of {total} records.
manager.categoryChartSummary: Counts of records for each of the {count} categories present in the data.
manager.weightChartSummary: Measured weight in kilograms for approved records only, totalling {total}.
manager.trendChartSummary: Number of records captured on each of the {days} days present in the data. No value is smoothed or projected.
manager.noFacilities: No record has been received at a facility yet.
manager.definitionsNotice: Verified weight is the weight measured at handoff for records in the approved and completed state. Nothing in progress is presented as verified recycling.

safety.description: Approved safety cards, by category and language.
safety.governanceTitle: How safety content reaches a collector
safety.governanceNotice: Only a published card whose review date has not passed can be shown to a collector or used to ground an explanation. A draft, an approved-but-unpublished card and an archived version are never served.
safety.noResults: No card matches the current filters.
safety.tableCaption: Safety cards by category and language

locations.description: Participating scrapyards, collection centres and recyclers for the category you choose.
locations.locationHint: Location is requested only when you use this control.
locations.locationUsed: Results are ordered from your current position.
locations.locationDenied: Position was not shared. Results are ordered from the chosen area.
locations.locationUnsupported: This browser cannot provide a position. Results are ordered from the chosen area.
locations.permissionDenied: Choose an area instead. The journey continues without your precise position.
locations.listingNotice: A directory listing does not by itself make a location an approved recycler. Only a programme-verified profile carries the verified badge.

recyclerRecords.title: Records at this facility
recyclerRecords.tableCaption: Records this facility may act on

recyclerProcessing.title: Record processing
recyclerProcessing.methodHint: The controlled result recorded against this record.
recyclerProcessing.notesHint: Describe what was done. This is stored as the recorded processing result.
recyclerProcessing.materialsHint: Add a row for each recovered material. Rows can be edited or removed until you submit.
recyclerProcessing.materialsRequired: Material recovery needs at least one material row.
recyclerProcessing.materialsInvalid: Every row needs a material name and a weight greater than zero.
recyclerProcessing.overWeightTitle: Recovered material exceeds the received weight
recyclerProcessing.overWeightNotice: This will be flagged for review. Check the weights before submitting.
recyclerProcessing.evidenceAlternative: The completion photograph recorded for this processing

imageRejected.unsupported_type: Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
imageRejected.too_large: That image is larger than 12 MB. Take a new photograph or choose a smaller file.

recyclerProcessing.confirmDescription: Record {reference} will be updated with {total} of recovered material.
recyclerProcessing.fixErrors: Some details still need attention. Check the highlighted fields.
recyclerProcessing.reviewToast: Processing recorded. The record needs review.
recyclerProcessing.completeNotice: Processing was recorded with no outstanding flags, so the record is approved and counts towards verified recovery.
recyclerProcessing.reviewNotice: Processing was recorded. A programme reviewer will decide this record before it can count towards verified recovery.
recyclerProcessing.terminalTitle: This record holds a final decision
recyclerProcessing.terminalNotice: A decided record cannot be edited. A change needs a reviewed amendment.
recyclerProcessing.alreadyRecordedNotice: This record already holds processing details. Open the record to review them.
recyclerProcessing.notReceivedTitle: This record has not been received yet
recyclerProcessing.notReceivedNotice: Record receipt at intake first. Processing can only be recorded after handoff.
recyclerProcessing.evidenceAttached: A completion photograph is attached to the draft.

recyclerProcessingQueue.title: Processing
recyclerProcessingQueue.description: Records received at this facility, and the processing details recorded against them.
recyclerProcessingQueue.noneAwaiting: Every received record has its processing details.
recyclerProcessingQueue.noneRecorded: No processing has been recorded at this facility yet.

recyclerAccount.title: Facility account
recyclerAccount.assignedLocations: Receiving locations you may act on
recyclerAccount.scopeNotice: Records destined for another facility cannot be received here. The service refuses the action; hiding a control is not the check.

reviewDetail.whyHeading: Why this record is in review
reviewDetail.integrityNotice: The digest detects later change to the recorded content. It does not prove that the handoff happened, and it does not make a photograph or a weight truthful. Judge the evidence itself.
reviewDetail.decisionIntro: Every decision needs a reason code and a note. A correction request also needs the correction described.

decisionHint.approve: The record is complete and the evidence supports it. It becomes approved and counts towards verified recovery.
decisionHint.request_correction: More information is needed. The record stays in review and the responsible user is asked for the correction.
decisionHint.reject: The record cannot be verified from the evidence. It is rejected and never counts towards verified recovery.

reviewDetail.noteHint: Explain the decision in your own words. This is stored with the record.
reviewDetail.noteRequired: A reviewer note is required for every decision.
reviewDetail.correctionHint: Describe exactly what needs to change or be supplied.
reviewDetail.correctionRequired: Describe the correction the record needs.
reviewDetail.confirmDescription: {decision} will be recorded against record {reference}. A decision cannot be replaced.
reviewDetail.fixErrors: Some details still need attention. Check the highlighted fields.

decided.approved_and_completed: Record approved. It now counts towards verified recovery.
decided.rejected: Record rejected. It does not count towards verified recovery.
decided.under_review: Correction requested. The record stays in review.

reviewDetail.readOnlyTitle: This record holds a final decision
reviewDetail.readOnlyNotice: The decision, its reason and its note are part of the record's history and cannot be replaced here.
reviewDetail.notReviewableTitle: This record is not awaiting a decision
reviewDetail.notReviewableNotice: Only a record under review can receive a decision. This view is read-only.
reviewDetail.unknownLocation: Location not in the reviewed directory

reviewAssigned.title: Assigned records
reviewAssigned.description: Records you have decided or asked about, and records under review that no reviewer has touched yet.
reviewAssigned.unassignedHeading: Under review, not yet picked up
reviewAssigned.none: Nothing in this list right now.

reviewDecisions.title: Decisions audit
reviewDecisions.description: Every recorded decision, with its reason and note. Entries are read-only.

reviewHistory.title: System history
reviewHistory.description: Every accepted state change across records, newest first. The history is append-only.

reports.title: Programme reports
reports.description: Filter the records, check the totals, then download the same selection as a CSV file.
reports.verifiedDefinition: Only records in the {state} state contribute to verified weight. Every other status is shown but excluded from that total.
reports.tableCaption: Records matching the current report filters
reports.exportNotice: The file contains the records matching the filters above. It carries no collector identifier, telephone number, precise coordinate or evidence URL.

settings.title: Programme settings
settings.description: Only settings this application actually applies are offered here.
settings.unsaved: Nothing is saved until you confirm. Leaving this page will discard the changes.
settings.nameRequired: Enter a programme name of at least two characters.
settings.currencyHint: Three uppercase letters, for example GHS. Used for the final price at handoff.
settings.currencyInvalid: Use three uppercase letters, for example GHS.
settings.countryHint: Two uppercase letters, for example GH. Stored on every new record's approximate area.
settings.countryInvalid: Use two uppercase letters, for example GH.
settings.thresholdHint: A received weight differing from the declared weight by more than this is flagged for review.
settings.showUnverifiedLabel: Offer locations that are not programme verified
settings.showUnverifiedHint: When this is off, only programme-verified locations are offered to collectors. A verified badge is shown only for a verified profile either way.
settings.languagesHint: English cannot be removed because it is the declared translation fallback.
settings.languagesRequired: Keep at least one language available.
settings.englishRequired: English must remain available as the translation fallback.
settings.periodHint: Used as the starting date range on the reports screen.
settings.periodInvalid: Enter a period between 1 and 365 days.
settings.defaultStatesHint: Leave all unchecked to start with every status included.
settings.confirmDescription: The weight threshold and language choices take effect immediately for every role.
settings.fixErrors: Some values are not valid. Check the highlighted fields.

ledger.title: Records ledger
ledger.description: Every record in the programme, with its revision and integrity digest. The ledger is read-only.
ledger.digestNotice: A digest detects later change to the recorded content. It does not prove that a recorded event happened.

managementLocations.title: Recovery locations
managementLocations.description: The reviewed directory, with each profile's verification state and the records received there.
managementLocations.badgeNotice: Only a manager-reviewed profile carries the programme-verified badge. A directory listing alone does not make a location an approved recycler.

prices.title: Price references
prices.description: The dated reference data behind every indicative estimate, at the condition you choose.
prices.unitNotice: Item categories are priced per item; mixed scrap is priced per kilogram. Amounts are in {currency}.
prices.disclaimer: Every figure is an indicative range from fictional demonstration reference data. It is not an offer, not guaranteed income, and a photograph cannot measure weight or value.

safetyEditor.languageHint: A card covers one category in one language. Category and language are fixed once the card exists.
safetyEditor.translatedFromHint: Record the approved language this wording was translated from, so the original meaning can be checked.
safetyEditor.aiAssistedHint: Approval is still human. This flag is stored with the card and shown to collectors.
safetyEditor.questionsIntro: Every card must answer all five. Keep wording conservative and never describe a dismantling step.

questionHint.what_is_it: Name the item plainly and describe its obvious parts.
questionHint.possible_dangers: Name what may be inside and why it matters. Do not speculate.
questionHint.prohibited_actions: State clearly what must not be done, including opening, cutting and burning.
questionHint.safe_actions_now: Give the safe holding steps a person can take immediately.
questionHint.suitable_destination: Refer the reader to a programme-verified location or a trained technician.

safetyEditor.sourcesIntro: Record the guidance this card is based on. A reviewer verifies each source before approval.
safetyEditor.sourceIncomplete: Every source needs both a title and a reference.
safetyEditor.fixErrors: Some details still need attention. Check the highlighted fields.
safetyEditor.readOnlyTitle: This card is no longer a draft
safetyEditor.readOnlyNotice: Approved, published and archived cards are read-only, so approved wording is never changed silently. Create a new draft version instead.
safetyEditor.previewTitle: This is what a collector reads
safetyEditor.previewNotice: The preview uses the card's own language and text direction, so right-to-left wording can be checked before publishing.
safetyEditor.previewEmptyAnswer: This answer has not been written yet.
safetyEditor.approveIntro: Approval records who approved the wording and when it must be reviewed again. It does not yet make the card current.
safetyEditor.approverRequired: Name the person or panel that approved this wording.
safetyEditor.reviewDateHint: After this date the card stops being served and the approved fallback is shown instead.
safetyEditor.reviewDateInvalid: The review date must be after the approval date.
safetyEditor.approveConfirmDescription: The approver and dates are stored with the card. The card is not published yet.
safetyEditor.publishIntro: Publishing makes this the current card for its category and language. The version it replaces is archived, not overwritten.
safetyEditor.publishConfirmDescription: Collectors will see this wording immediately, and the previously published version is archived.
safetyEditor.returnToDraft: Return to draft for more editing
safetyEditor.archiveIntro: Archiving stops the card being served. Collectors then receive the approved fallback until another card is published.
safetyEditor.archiveConfirmDescription: Collectors will stop seeing this wording and will receive the approved fallback for this category and language.

statusChanged.published: Card published. Collectors see it now.
statusChanged.archived: Card archived. It is no longer served.

safetyTranslations.title: Translations
safetyTranslations.description: Which categories have current approved guidance in each language.
safetyTranslations.policyTitle: Missing translations are shown, not substituted
safetyTranslations.policyNotice: A collector asking for a language with no published card receives the approved fallback and referral. English is never presented as though it were another language.
safetyTranslations.missingCount: {count} category and language combination(s) have no published card.
safetyTranslations.tableCaption: Safety card coverage by category and language

safetyApprovals.title: Approval queue
safetyApprovals.description: Cards waiting for approval, cards approved but not yet current, and published cards past their review date.
safetyApprovals.noDrafts: No card is waiting for approval.
safetyApprovals.noApproved: Every approved card has been published.
safetyApprovals.noExpired: No published card has passed its review date.

safetyPublished.title: Published content
safetyPublished.description: Exactly what a collector can be served now, and the archived versions kept behind it.
safetyPublished.servableCount: {count} card(s) can be served to collectors.
safetyPublished.noneNotice: Every category and language currently falls back to the approved referral. Publish an approved card to change that.
safetyPublished.noArchived: No card has been superseded yet.

mlCorrections.description: Stored predictions, the categories people confirmed, and which of them may be used in a future dataset.
mlCorrections.boundaryTitle: What this screen does and does not do
mlCorrections.boundaryNotice: A stored correction is labelled feedback. Approving it marks it usable in a future, separately released dataset. Nothing here retrains or redeploys a model, and no correction changes the active model.
mlCorrections.noResults: No stored prediction matches the current filters.
mlCorrections.imageAlternative: The photograph this prediction was made from
mlCorrections.noImage: No stored image for this prediction on this device
mlCorrections.approveConfirmTitle: Approve this label for a future dataset?
mlCorrections.approveConfirmDescription: The item is marked usable in a future dataset release. The active model is not changed and no training starts.

decided.approved_for_training_dataset: Approved for a future dataset. No training has started.

mlCorrections.decidedNotice: A reviewed item keeps its state so the decision is auditable.
mlCorrections.noRetrainingNotice: Training a model is a separate, controlled step with its own versioned dataset release. It never happens from this screen.

mlModel.title: Model information
mlModel.description: The registered artefact, its evaluation figures and its known limits.
mlModel.taskNotice: The model assigns one of seven categories to one image. It is not an object detector: it produces no bounding boxes, no object counts and no per-object output, and it cannot measure weight or value.
mlModel.checksumNotRecorded: Not recorded in the training artefact
mlModel.metricsCaption: Evaluation metrics for each supported category
mlModel.f1ChartSummary: F1 score per category as a percentage, against a macro F1 of {macro}.
mlModel.registryNotice: {count} model version is registered. Activation and rollback are not supported by any service here, so the active version is factual metadata rather than a control.

mlConfiguration.title: Model configuration
mlConfiguration.description: The settings this application applies to predictions. None of them retrain or redeploy a model.
mlConfiguration.unsaved: Nothing is saved until you confirm.
mlConfiguration.versionHint: Only versions present in the registry can be selected.
mlConfiguration.singleVersionNotice: There is nothing to switch between, and no service here supports activation or rollback, so this is shown as metadata rather than as a control that would not work.
mlConfiguration.thresholdEffect: A prediction scoring below the threshold is treated as low confidence: the collector is shown all seven categories and must choose one.
mlConfiguration.routingLabel: When a prediction is low confidence

routing.manual_confirmation_and_feedback: Ask for manual confirmation and store the outcome as feedback

routingHint.manual_confirmation: The collector chooses the category. Nothing is stored for later dataset work.
routingHint.manual_confirmation_and_feedback: The collector chooses the category and the outcome is stored as labelled feedback for a future, separately released dataset.

mlConfiguration.manualIntro: Categories listed here always require manual confirmation, whatever the model scored. Mixed scrap is a sensible default because it is the weakest category in evaluation.
mlConfiguration.confirmDescription: A threshold of {threshold} takes effect immediately for every new capture. No model is retrained or redeployed.
mlConfiguration.fixErrors: Some values are not valid. Check the highlighted fields.

mlLabels.title: Approved labels
mlLabels.description: Labels approved for use in a future dataset release.
mlLabels.boundaryTitle: These are candidates, not a dataset
mlLabels.boundaryNotice: A dataset release is a separate, versioned, human-approved step. Nothing on this screen changes the active model or starts training.
mlLabels.chartSummary: Counts of the {count} approved labels grouped by the category a person confirmed.
mlLabels.tableCaption: Labels approved for a future dataset release

mlExports.title: Data exports
mlExports.description: Export the stored labelled feedback for dataset preparation.
mlExports.privacyNotice: The file carries model output, the confirmed label and review metadata. It carries no collector identifier and no image content, so it cannot become a way to distribute personal data or evidence.

flags.judgementNotice: A flag records that a value needs human judgement. It is not proof of wrongdoing.
flags.WEIGHT_DISCREPANCY: Received weight differs from the declared weight beyond the programme threshold
flags.CATEGORY_DISAGREEMENT: The receiving facility confirmed a different category
flags.DUPLICATE_EVIDENCE_DIGEST: Identical evidence content already exists on another record
flags.MISSING_MATERIAL_WEIGHTS: Material recovery was recorded without any material weights
flags.PROCESSED_WEIGHT_ABOVE_RECEIVED: Recovered material weighs more than the received item

safetyQuestions.possible_dangers: What may be dangerous inside it?
safetyQuestions.safe_actions_now: What can I safely do now?

errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Your work has not been discarded.
errors.networkUnavailable: The network is unavailable. Keep this page open and try again when connected.
errors.permissionDenied: The current role may not perform this action.
errors.invalidTransition: That action is not allowed at this point in the record's journey.
errors.validationFailed: Some values are not valid. Check the highlighted fields.
errors.idempotencyConflict: This action was already sent with different values. Refresh and try again.
errors.facilityNotAssigned: That receiving location is not assigned to this facility.
errors.alreadyDecided: This record already holds a final decision.
errors.cardNotEditable: Only a draft card can be edited.
errors.cardTransition: That status change is not allowed for this card.
errors.modelVersionUnknown: That model version is not in the registry.

transition.TERMINAL_STATE: A decided record cannot be changed by this action.
transition.TRANSITION_NOT_ALLOWED: That action is not valid for the record's current state.
transition.ROLE_NOT_ALLOWED: The current role cannot perform this action.
transition.MISSING_EVIDENCE: Required evidence is missing for this action.
transition.UNRESOLVED_FLAGS: A review flag must be resolved first.
transition.OFFLINE_NOT_ALLOWED: This action needs a connection before it can be recorded.

charts.emptyDescription: This chart fills in once matching records exist.
charts.showTable: Show the values as a table

evidence.heading: Evidence and provenance
evidence.none: No evidence has been recorded for this record yet.
evidence.noPreview: No stored preview for this evidence on this device
evidence.digestNotice: A digest detects later change to the recorded content. It does not prove that the recorded event happened, and it does not make the content truthful.

qr.presentHint: Show this code to the receiving facility, or read out the transfer code below.
qr.payloadNotice: The code contains only the contract version, the record identifier and an opaque lookup token. It contains no name, telephone number or location.
qr.cameraIdle: The camera is off. Start it, choose a photograph of the code, or type the transfer code.
qr.cameraDenied: Intake still works: choose a photograph of the code, or type the transfer code below.
qr.cameraUnsupportedTitle: This browser cannot open the camera
qr.cameraUnsupported: Choose a photograph of the code, or type the transfer code below.
qr.cameraFailed: Another application may be using it. Choose a photograph, or type the transfer code below.
qr.imageErrorTitle: That image could not be used
qr.imageNoSymbol: No QR code was found in that image. Try a closer, sharper photograph.
qr.imageUnreadable: That file could not be read as an image.
qr.codeHint: Twelve characters in three groups, as read out by the collector.
qr.codeInvalid: Enter the twelve-character code, for example 7K3Q-M9XD-2HVT.
qr.inactiveNotice: Submit the record to activate the QR code and the manual transfer code.
qr.manualCodeNotice: Share the manual code only with the receiving facility. It works like the QR code and stops working after handoff, expiry or reissue.
qr.expiredNotice: Reissue the code to hand this item over.
qr.usedNotice: The handoff is recorded, so the code no longer works.
qr.reissueTitle: Reissue the QR and manual codes?
qr.reissueDescription: The current QR code and manual code stop working immediately. Use this if a code was lost, shared or expired.
qr.reissued: New codes issued. The previous codes no longer work.

register.boundaryNotice: Creating an account needs a production identity provider, which this demonstration deliberately does not include. Use the role sign-in to open a workspace.

safety.selectCategoryFirst: Confirm a category to see its approved safety guide.
safety.metadataSummary: Card source, approval and review dates
safety.aiAssistedYes: Yes, wording was assisted and then approved by a person
safety.aiAssistedNo: No, the approved wording is shown unchanged
safety.unavailableFallback: Do not open, break or burn the item. Contact a programme-verified receiving location or a trained technician.
safety.fallbackTitle: No approved guide for this item and language

fallbackReason.no_approved_card: No approved card exists for this category in the selected language, so no guidance was generated.
fallbackReason.provider_unavailable: The guidance service is unavailable, so the approved referral is shown instead.
fallbackReason.invalid_generated_output: Generated wording failed validation and was not shown.
fallbackReason.offline_cache_unavailable: No approved card is available offline on this device.

safety.fallbackAdvice: Do not open, break or burn the item.
safety.fallbackReferral: Contact a programme-verified receiving location or a trained technician.

record.draftTitle: This record is still a draft
record.draftNotice: A draft has not been submitted, so no QR code has been issued and no facility can receive it yet.
record.lowConfidenceNotice: The model score was below the configured threshold, so the collector had to choose the category.
record.classifierLimitation: This is a single-item image classification result, not a guarantee. It cannot count objects, measure weight or prove what happened to the item.
record.unknownLocation: Location not in the reviewed directory
record.noEvents: No events have been recorded for this record yet.
record.terminalTitle: This record holds a final decision
record.terminalNotice: A decided record is read-only. A change needs a reviewed amendment, not an edit.

nextStep.draft: The collector still needs to submit this record.
nextStep.submitted: The record is being published for handoff.
nextStep.awaiting_handoff: Scan the collector's code at intake to record receipt.
nextStep.received: Record the processing details and recovered material weights.
nextStep.processing_recorded: Processing has been recorded. Nothing further is needed here.
nextStep.completed: The record is complete and awaiting its final programme check.
nextStep.under_review: A programme reviewer is deciding this record.
nextStep.approved_and_completed: The record is approved and counts towards verified recovery.
nextStep.rejected: The record was rejected and does not count towards verified recovery.
